/-!
SOURCE ONLY / UNCOMPILED / ZERO NEW FORMAL OR KERNEL CREDIT.

A fixed original causal atlas is evaluated on the individual OLD prime
logarithms, then multiplied by the unchanged Gamma5 physical profile.
The smooth positive argument is the existing clamp. Its removal is a
global product identity because the original profile vanishes whenever
a physical coordinate is at or below half the positive floor.

All derivative constants are chosen after the fixed atlas, rank ceiling,
width and order, but before the target, total level, floor, accepted atom
set, physical base or Euler word. The finite atom sum is bounded explicitly;
smoothness alone is not used as a global derivative bound.

This constructs no smooth realization of an arbitrary discrete selected
history. It proves no ordinary-mass, J, distribution or PP assertion.
-/

/-- The original separate old coordinates, without collapsing their product. -/
def oldLogCoordinates {k r : ℕ} (N : ℝ)
    (v : E (k + (2 + r))) : Fin k → ℝ :=
  fun i => log (v (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)) / log N

/-- The existing positive clamp makes every logarithm globally smooth. -/
def safeOldLogCoordinates {k r : ℕ} (N b : ℝ)
    (v : E (k + (2 + r))) : Fin k → ℝ :=
  fun i => log (positiveArg (b / 2) (v (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i))) / log N

/-- Fixed atlas readout times the original Gamma5 profile. No primality,
coprimality, selected-history indicator or arithmetic filter is inserted. -/
def atlasProfile {k r : ℕ} (P : Plan) (accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (logQ N width b : ℝ) (v : E (k + (2 + r))) : ℝ :=
  finPhysicalProfile logQ N width b v *
    readout P accept (safeOldLogCoordinates N b v)

theorem contDiff_atlasProfile {k r : ℕ} (P : Plan)
    (accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop) (logQ N width : ℝ) {b : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 < b) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (atlasProfile (r := r) P accept logQ N width b) := by
  have hsafe : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (safeOldLogCoordinates (k := k) (r := r) N b) := by
    apply contDiff_pi.mpr
    intro i
    exact (((positiveArg_smooth (b / 2)).comp
      (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i))).log
        (fun v => (positiveArg_pos (half_pos hb) (v _)).ne')).div_const (log N)
  exact (contDiff_finPhysicalProfile logQ N width hb).mul
    ((readout_smooth P accept).comp hsafe)

/-- This equality holds on the whole real coordinate space. The singular
unclamped logarithms are used only in an equal product, never to assert
smoothness of their factors at zero. -/
theorem atlasProfile_eq_original_weight {k r : ℕ} (P : Plan)
    (accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop) (logQ N width : ℝ) {b : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (v : E (k + (2 + r))) :
    atlasProfile P accept logQ N width b v =
      finPhysicalProfile logQ N width b v *
        readout P accept (oldLogCoordinates N v) := by
  unfold atlasProfile
  by_cases hz : finPhysicalProfile logQ N width b v = 0
  · simp only [hz, zero_mul]
  · congr 1
    apply congrArg (readout P accept)
    funext i
    have hi := physicalProfile_nonzero_lower hb hz (Sum.inl i)
    change b / 2 < v (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i) at hi
    simp only [safeOldLogCoordinates, oldLogCoordinates,
      positiveArg_eq (half_pos hb) hi.le]

theorem atlasProfile_nonneg {k r : ℕ} (P : Plan)
    (accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop) (logQ N width b : ℝ)
    (v : E (k + (2 + r))) :
    0 ≤ atlasProfile P accept logQ N width b v := by
  apply mul_nonneg (physicalProfile_bounds logQ N width b (finToPhysical k r v)).1
  unfold readout
  apply sum_nonneg
  intro j _
  by_cases hj : accept j
  · simpa only [if_pos hj] using atom_nonneg P j (safeOldLogCoordinates N b v)
  · simp only [if_neg hj, le_refl]

/-- Only the original physical support can contribute. -/
theorem atlasProfile_nonzero_original {k r : ℕ} (P : Plan)
    (accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop) (logQ N width b : ℝ)
    (v : E (k + (2 + r)))
    (hne : atlasProfile P accept logQ N width b v ≠ 0) :
    finPhysicalProfile logQ N width b v ≠ 0 :=
  (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hne).1

/-- Compactness of a fixed atlas mask supplies its global scalar bounds.
The existing plateau lemma is reused; no new derivative estimate is proved. -/
private theorem mask_scalar_bound (P : Plan) (j : Code P) :
    ScalarBound (mask P j) := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (mask_compact P j :
    IsCompact (tsupport (mask P j))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (continuous_id.continuousOn : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x) _)
  apply plateau_bound (mask_smooth P j)
    (fun x => by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (mask_nonneg P j x)]
      exact mask_le_one P j x)
    (l := -(max 0 B + 1)) (u := max 0 B + 1) (v := 0) (w := 0)
  · intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    have hbound : |x| ≤ B := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, id] using hB x
        (subset_closure (show x ∈ Function.support (mask P j) from hn))
    have hleft := (abs_le.mp hbound).1
    linarith [le_max_right (0 : ℝ) B]
  · intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    have hbound : |x| ≤ B := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, id] using hB x
        (subset_closure (show x ∈ Function.support (mask P j) from hn))
    have hright := (abs_le.mp hbound).2
    linarith [le_max_right (0 : ℝ) B]

/-- Every parameter below varies after the atlas derivative constant. -/
private abbrev ChartParam (P : Plan) (k : ℕ) :=
  ((Fin k → Code P) → Prop) × {N : ℝ // 2 ≤ N} × (Fin k → ℝ)

private def readoutChart {k r : ℕ} (P : Plan) (a : ChartParam P k)
    (u : E (k + (2 + r))) : ℝ :=
  readout P a.1 (fun i =>
    (a.2.2 i + u (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)) / log a.2.1.val)

private theorem atom_chart_budget (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) (j : Fin k → Code P) :
    BoundedDerivatives (fun (a : ChartParam P k) (u : E (k + (2 + r))) =>
      atom P j (fun i =>
        (a.2.2 i + u (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)) / log a.2.1.val)) := by
  have H (i : Fin k) : BoundedDerivatives
      (fun (a : ChartParam P k) (u : E (k + (2 + r))) =>
        mask P (j i) ((a.2.2 i + u (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)) / log a.2.1.val)) := by
    have h := Part5OriginalH430ClassicalSmoothEulerBounds.affine
      (mask_scalar_bound P (j i))
      (fun a : ChartParam P k => a.2.2 i / log a.2.1.val)
      (fun a : ChartParam P k => 1 / log a.2.1.val)
      (coord (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i))
      (R := 1 / log 2)
      (one_div_pos.mpr (log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2))).le
      (fun a => by
        have hL := log_le_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) a.2.1.property
        have hpos := log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (one_div_nonneg.mpr (hpos.le.trans hL))]
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpos hL)
    convert h using 1
    funext a u
    apply congrArg (mask P (j i))
    simp only [coord, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]
    ring
  simpa only [atom] using
    (Part5OriginalH430ClassicalSmoothEulerBounds.prod
      (univ : Finset (Fin k)) _ H)

/-- Uniformity in accept is obtained by an explicit sum over the fixed
finite atlas, including the unique empty-coordinate atom when k = 0. -/
private theorem readout_chart_budget (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) :
    BoundedDerivatives (readoutChart (k := k) (r := r) P) := by
  let F (j : Fin k → Code P) (a : ChartParam P k)
      (u : E (k + (2 + r))) : ℝ :=
    if a.1 j then atom P j (fun i =>
      (a.2.2 i + u (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)) / log a.2.1.val) else 0
  have H (j : Fin k → Code P) : BoundedDerivatives (F j) := by
    have hj := atom_chart_budget P k r j
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a
      by_cases ha : a.1 j
      · simpa only [F, if_pos ha] using hj.1 a
      · simpa only [F, if_neg ha] using
          (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E (k + (2 + r)) => (0 : ℝ)))
    · intro q
      obtain ⟨C, hC, HC⟩ := hj.2 q
      refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
      intro a u
      by_cases ha : a.1 j
      · simpa only [F, if_pos ha] using HC a u
      · simp only [F, if_neg ha]
        cases q with
        | zero => simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, norm_zero] using hC
        | succ q =>
          simpa only [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.succ_ne_zero q),
            Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero] using hC
  have Hsum (S : Finset (Fin k → Code P)) :
      BoundedDerivatives (fun a u => ∑ j ∈ S, F j a u) := by
    induction S using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
        simpa only [sum_empty, sub_self] using
          (Part5OriginalH430ClassicalSmoothEulerBounds.sub
            (Part5OriginalH430ClassicalSmoothEulerBounds.one
              (ι := ChartParam P k) (d := k + (2 + r)))
            Part5OriginalH430ClassicalSmoothEulerBounds.one)
    | @insert j S hj ih =>
        simpa only [sum_insert hj] using
          Part5OriginalH430ClassicalSmoothEulerBounds.add (H j) ih
  have hreadout : readoutChart (k := k) (r := r) P =
      (fun (a : ChartParam P k) (u : E (k + (2 + r))) =>
        ∑ j ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin k → Code P)), F j a u) := by
    funext a u
    unfold readoutChart readout
    apply Finset.sum_congr
    · ext j
      simp
    · intro j _
      rfl
  rw [hreadout]
  exact Hsum univ

private structure ProfileParam (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) where
  accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop
  N : {N : ℝ // 2 ≤ N}
  logQ : ℝ
  b : {b : ℝ // 0 < b}
  base : E (k + (2 + r))

private theorem product_chart_budget (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ)
    (width : ℝ) (hw : 0 < width) :
    BoundedDerivatives (fun (a : ProfileParam P k r) (u : E (k + (2 + r))) =>
      finPhysicalProfile a.logQ a.N.val width a.b.val (flow a.base u) *
        readout P a.accept (fun i =>
          (log (a.base (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)) + u (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)) /
            log a.N.val)) := by
  let F := fun (a : ProfileParam P k r) (u : E (k + (2 + r))) =>
    finPhysicalProfile a.logQ a.N.val width a.b.val (flow a.base u)
  let G := fun (a : ProfileParam P k r) (u : E (k + (2 + r))) =>
    readoutChart P
      (a.accept, a.N, fun i => log (a.base (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i))) u
  have hF : BoundedDerivatives F := by
    refine ⟨fun a => (contDiff_finPhysicalProfile a.logQ a.N.val width
      a.b.property).comp (flow_smooth a.base), ?_⟩
    intro q
    obtain ⟨C, hC, HC⟩ := finPhysicalProfile_chart_tensor_budget k r q
    refine ⟨C * (1 + width⁻¹) ^ q,
      mul_nonneg hC (pow_nonneg (add_nonneg zero_le_one (inv_nonneg.mpr hw.le)) _), ?_⟩
    intro a u
    exact HC a.logQ a.N.val a.b.val width a.b.property hw a.base u
  have hG : BoundedDerivatives G := by
    have H := readout_chart_budget P k r
    refine ⟨fun a => H.1
      (a.accept, a.N, fun i => log (a.base (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i))), ?_⟩
    intro q
    obtain ⟨C, hC, HC⟩ := H.2 q
    exact ⟨C, hC, fun a u => HC
      (a.accept, a.N, fun i => log (a.base (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i))) u⟩
  simpa only [F, G, readoutChart] using
    Part5OriginalH430ClassicalSmoothEulerBounds.mul hF hG

/-- Full chart bounds for the globally smooth product, including negative
and zero bases. The width is fixed before the constant. -/
theorem atlasProfile_chart_tensor_budget (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ)
    (width : ℝ) (hw : 0 < width) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (N : ℝ), 2 ≤ N → ∀ (logQ b : ℝ), 0 < b →
      ∀ (accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop) (v u : E (k + (2 + r))),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ q
          (fun z => atlasProfile P accept logQ N width b (flow v z)) u‖ ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, H⟩ := (product_chart_budget P k r width hw).2 q
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro N hN logQ b hb accept v u
  by_cases hv : ∀ i, 0 < v i
  · have heq : (fun z => atlasProfile P accept logQ N width b (flow v z)) =
        fun z => finPhysicalProfile logQ N width b (flow v z) *
          readout P accept (fun i =>
            (log (v (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)) + z (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)) / log N) := by
      funext z
      rw [atlasProfile_eq_original_weight P accept logQ N width hb]
      congr 1
      apply congrArg (readout P accept)
      funext i
      simp only [oldLogCoordinates, flow,
        log_mul (hv (Fin.castAdd (2 + r) i)).ne' (exp_pos _).ne', log_exp]
    rw [heq]
    exact H ⟨accept, ⟨N, hN⟩, logQ, ⟨b, hb⟩, v⟩ u
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.mp hv
    have heq : (fun z => atlasProfile P accept logQ N width b (flow v z)) =
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      funext z
      have hz : finPhysicalProfile logQ N width b (flow v z) = 0 := by
        apply physicalProfile_eq_zero_of_slot_le_half hb ((slotEquiv k r).symm i)
        change flow v z (slotEquiv k r ((slotEquiv k r).symm i)) ≤ b / 2
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hi)
          (exp_pos (z i)).le).trans (half_pos hb).le
      simp only [atlasProfile, hz, zero_mul]
    rw [heq]
    cases q with
    | zero => simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, norm_zero] using hC
    | succ q =>
        simpa only [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.succ_ne_zero q),
          Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero] using hC

/-- The exact original list-fold Euler operators are bounded at every
physical point; the fixed finite set of orders is summed before N. -/
theorem atlasProfile_mixedEuler_budget (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ)
    (width : ℝ) (hw : 0 < width) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (N : ℝ), 2 ≤ N → ∀ (logQ b : ℝ), 0 < b →
      ∀ (accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
        (w : List (Fin (k + (2 + r)))) (v : E (k + (2 + r))),
        w.length ≤ m → |eulerWord w (atlasProfile P accept logQ N width b) v| ≤ C := by
  choose C hC HC using fun q : ℕ => atlasProfile_chart_tensor_budget P k r width hw q
  refine ⟨∑ q ∈ range (m + 1), C q, sum_nonneg (fun q _ => hC q), ?_⟩
  intro N hN logQ b hb accept w v hwm
  exact ((norm_bound_at_zero (contDiff_atlasProfile P accept logQ N width hb) w v).trans
    (HC w.length N hN logQ b hb accept v 0)).trans
      (single_le_sum (fun q _ => hC q) (mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hwm)))

/-- One constant works for every permitted old/tail split and every
accepted subset of its fixed atlas. The rank ceiling is fixed before N. -/
theorem atlasProfile_boundedRank_mixedEuler_budget (P : Plan) (K : ℕ)
    (width : ℝ) (hw : 0 < width) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (k r : ℕ), k + 2 + r ≤ K →
      ∀ (N : ℝ), 2 ≤ N → ∀ (logQ b : ℝ), 0 < b →
      ∀ (accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
        (w : List (Fin (k + (2 + r)))) (v : E (k + (2 + r))),
        w.length ≤ m → |eulerWord w (atlasProfile P accept logQ N width b) v| ≤ C := by
  choose C hC HC using fun k r : ℕ => atlasProfile_mixedEuler_budget P k r width hw m
  have hrow (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ∑ r ∈ range (K + 1), C k r :=
    sum_nonneg (fun r _ => hC k r)
  refine ⟨∑ k ∈ range (K + 1), ∑ r ∈ range (K + 1), C k r,
    sum_nonneg (fun k _ => hrow k), ?_⟩
  intro k r hkr N hN logQ b hb accept w v hwm
  have hk : k ≤ K := by omega
  have hr : r ≤ K := by omega
  have hinner : C k r ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (K + 1), C k j :=
    single_le_sum (fun j _ => hC k j) (mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hr))
  have houter : (∑ j ∈ range (K + 1), C k j) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ range (K + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (K + 1), C i j :=
    single_le_sum (fun i _ => hrow i) (mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk))
  exact (HC k r N hN logQ b hb accept w v hwm).trans (hinner.trans houter)

/-- Natural constants in the unchanged Family.mixedEuler format, with
logarithmic exponent zero. This is a derivative-field supplier on N >= 2,
not a replacement Family or a smooth realization of discrete B. -/
theorem atlasProfile_family_mixedEuler_budget (P : Plan) (K : ℕ)
    (width : ℝ) (hw : 0 < width) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C B : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ B = 0 ∧ ∀ (k r : ℕ), k + 2 + r ≤ K →
      ∀ (N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ∀ (logQ b : ℝ), 0 < b →
      ∀ (accept : (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
        (w : List (Fin (k + (2 + r)))) (v : E (k + (2 + r))),
        w.length ≤ m →
        |eulerWord w (atlasProfile P accept logQ (N : ℝ) width b) v| ≤
          (C : ℝ) * (log ((N : ℝ) + 2)) ^ B := by
  obtain ⟨C0, _hC0, H⟩ := atlasProfile_boundedRank_mixedEuler_budget P K width hw m
  let C : ℕ := Nat.ceil C0 + 1
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; omega
  have hround : C0 ≤ (C : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (Nat.ceil C0 : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      _ ≤ (C : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [C]
        exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ (Nat.ceil C0)
  refine ⟨C, 0, hC, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro k r hkr N hN logQ b hb accept w v hwm
  have hN' : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using
    (H k r hkr (N : ℝ) hN' logQ b hb accept w v hwm).trans hround

end

/-!
SOURCE ONLY / UNCOMPILED / ZERO NEW FORMAL OR KERNEL CREDIT.

The original geometric Family is multiplied by the fixed causal atlas
readout. Its original rank and scale gates are reused as functions; no
second scale truncation or replacement support argument is defined.
The only new rank conditional transports the old coordinates along the
same rank equality. Outside that rank its multiplier is one.

The accepted atom set may vary with the natural target. The atlas and
width stay fixed, and the preceding all-order atlas budget chooses its
constant before the entire accept function. This supplies a geometric
Family instance, not a smooth realization of an arbitrary discrete B,
an ordinary-mass estimate, or a PP licence.
-/
namespace ImbalancedChen.P2FiniteMarkedGamma5AtlasFamily

noncomputable section
open Finset Real
open Part5OriginalCausalSmoothAtlas (Plan Code)
open Part5OriginalH430JointQueryEnclosure (readout)
open P2FiniteMarkedGamma5AtlasEulerBudget
open P2FiniteMarkedGamma5AllRankEulerBudget
open P5Z.AdmissibleAllRankIntegerGeometricFamily (Family eulerWord)
open scoped Classical BigOperators ContDiff

/-- Multiply the existing gated ambient. The new conditional only casts
coordinates at the active rank; the existing ambient owns every zero gate. -/
def atlasAmbient (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ) (logQ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop) (T d : ℕ)
    (v : Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  P2FiniteMarkedGamma5GeometricFamily.ambient a width logQ k r T d v *
    if hd : d = k + (2 + r) then
      readout P (accept T)
        (safeOldLogCoordinates (k := k) (r := r) (T : ℝ) ((T : ℝ) ^ a)
          (fun i => v (Fin.cast hd.symm i)))
    else 1

theorem atlasAmbient_at_rank (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ)
    (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : scaleThreshold a ≤ (T : ℝ)) :
    atlasAmbient P k r a width logQ accept T (k + (2 + r)) =
      atlasProfile (r := r) P (accept T) (logQ T) (T : ℝ) width ((T : ℝ) ^ a) := by
  funext v
  simp only [atlasAmbient,
    P2FiniteMarkedGamma5GeometricFamily.ambient_at_rank a width logQ k r T hT,
    dif_pos True.intro, Fin.cast_eq_self, atlasProfile]

theorem atlasAmbient_zero_of_rank_ne (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ)
    (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (T d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ k + (2 + r)) :
    atlasAmbient P k r a width logQ accept T d = 0 := by
  funext v
  simp only [atlasAmbient,
    P2FiniteMarkedGamma5GeometricFamily.ambient_zero_of_rank_ne a width logQ k r T d hd,
    Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]

theorem atlasAmbient_zero_below_threshold (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ)
    (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (T d : ℕ) (hT : (T : ℝ) < scaleThreshold a) :
    atlasAmbient P k r a width logQ accept T d = 0 := by
  funext v
  simp only [atlasAmbient,
    P2FiniteMarkedGamma5GeometricFamily.ambient_zero_below_threshold
      a width logQ k r T d hT,
    Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]

theorem atlasAmbient_nonzero_original (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ)
    (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (T d : ℕ) (v : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hne : atlasAmbient P k r a width logQ accept T d v ≠ 0) :
    P2FiniteMarkedGamma5GeometricFamily.ambient a width logQ k r T d v ≠ 0 :=
  (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hne).1

theorem atlasAmbient_smooth (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (width : ℝ) (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (T d : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (atlasAmbient P k r a width logQ accept T d) := by
  by_cases hd : d = k + (2 + r)
  · subst d
    by_cases hT : scaleThreshold a ≤ (T : ℝ)
    · rw [atlasAmbient_at_rank P k r a width logQ accept T hT]
      have hT0 : 0 < (T : ℝ) :=
        zero_lt_one.trans (scaleThreshold_bounds ha hT).1
      exact contDiff_atlasProfile P (accept T) (logQ T) (T : ℝ) width
        (rpow_pos_of_pos hT0 a)
    · rw [atlasAmbient_zero_below_threshold P k r a width logQ accept T _
        (lt_of_not_ge hT)]
      exact contDiff_const
  · rw [atlasAmbient_zero_of_rank_ne P k r a width logQ accept T d hd]
    exact contDiff_const

theorem atlasAmbient_nonneg (P : Plan) (k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ)
    (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (T d : ℕ) (v : Fin d → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ atlasAmbient P k r a width logQ accept T d v := by
  by_cases hd : d = k + (2 + r)
  · subst d
    by_cases hT : scaleThreshold a ≤ (T : ℝ)
    · rw [atlasAmbient_at_rank P k r a width logQ accept T hT]
      exact atlasProfile_nonneg P (accept T) (logQ T) (T : ℝ) width ((T : ℝ) ^ a) v
    · rw [atlasAmbient_zero_below_threshold P k r a width logQ accept T _
        (lt_of_not_ge hT)]
      exact le_rfl
  · rw [atlasAmbient_zero_of_rank_ne P k r a width logQ accept T d hd]
    exact le_rfl

/-- The previous uniform constant precedes the complete accept function.
At every active natural target, the old threshold gives T >= 2. All
other branches are the old zero ambient, including T = 0 and b = 0. -/
theorem atlasAmbient_mixedEuler_budget (P : Plan) (K : ℕ) (width : ℝ)
    (hw : 0 < width) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (a : ℝ), 0 < a →
      ∀ (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (k r : ℕ), k + 2 + r ≤ K →
      ∀ (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
        (T d : ℕ) (w : List (Fin d)) (v : Fin d → ℝ), w.length ≤ m →
        |eulerWord w (atlasAmbient P k r a width logQ accept T d) v| ≤ (C : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨C, B, hC, hB, H⟩ := atlasProfile_family_mixedEuler_budget P K width hw m
  subst B
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro a ha logQ k r hkr accept T d w v hwm
  by_cases hd : d = k + (2 + r)
  · subst d
    by_cases hT : scaleThreshold a ≤ (T : ℝ)
    · rw [atlasAmbient_at_rank P k r a width logQ accept T hT]
      have hT1 : 1 < T := by exact_mod_cast (scaleThreshold_bounds ha hT).1
      have hT2 : 2 ≤ T := by omega
      have hT0 : 0 < (T : ℝ) :=
        zero_lt_one.trans (scaleThreshold_bounds ha hT).1
      simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using
        H k r hkr T hT2 (logQ T) ((T : ℝ) ^ a)
          (rpow_pos_of_pos hT0 a) (accept T) w v hwm
    · rw [atlasAmbient_zero_below_threshold P k r a width logQ accept T _
        (lt_of_not_ge hT), eulerWord_zero_eq]
      simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, abs_zero] using (Nat.cast_nonneg C : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C)
  · rw [atlasAmbient_zero_of_rank_ne P k r a width logQ accept T d hd, eulerWord_zero_eq]
    simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, abs_zero] using (Nat.cast_nonneg C : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C)

/-- The original Family is updated only by the actual atlas multiplier.
Its floor, product constants and finite prime support are inherited
directly from the existing geometric Family via support inclusion. -/
def atlasFamily (P : Plan) (K k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ) (logQ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hw : 0 < width) (hw1 : width ≤ 1)
    (hkr : k + 2 + r ≤ K) : Family K := by
  let A := P2FiniteMarkedGamma5GeometricFamily.geometricFamily
    K k r a width logQ ha hw hw1 hkr
  refine { A with
    ambient := fun T d => atlasAmbient P k r a width logQ accept T d.val
    smooth := fun T d => atlasAmbient_smooth P k r ha width logQ accept T d.val
    support := ?_
    finitePrimeSupport := ?_
    mixedEuler := ?_ }
  · intro T d v hne
    exact A.support T d v
      (atlasAmbient_nonzero_original P k r a width logQ accept T d.val v hne)
  · intro T d
    apply (A.finitePrimeSupport T d).subset
    intro u hu
    exact ⟨hu.1, atlasAmbient_nonzero_original P k r a width logQ accept
      T d.val (fun i => (u i : ℝ)) hu.2⟩
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC, H⟩ := atlasAmbient_mixedEuler_budget P K width hw m
    refine ⟨C, 0, hC, ?_⟩
    intro T d w v hwm
    simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using
      H a ha logQ k r hkr accept T d.val w v hwm

/-- Exact equality on the whole active-rank real space above the original
threshold, with the original individual old, fresh and tail coordinates. -/
theorem atlasFamily_at_rank (P : Plan) (K k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ)
    (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hw : 0 < width) (hw1 : width ≤ 1) (hkr : k + 2 + r ≤ K)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : scaleThreshold a ≤ (T : ℝ)) :
    (atlasFamily P K k r a width logQ accept ha hw hw1 hkr).ambient T
        ⟨k + (2 + r), by omega⟩ =
      atlasProfile (r := r) P (accept T) (logQ T) (T : ℝ) width ((T : ℝ) ^ a) :=
  atlasAmbient_at_rank P k r a width logQ accept T hT

theorem atlasFamily_zero_below_threshold (P : Plan) (K k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ)
    (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hw : 0 < width) (hw1 : width ≤ 1) (hkr : k + 2 + r ≤ K)
    (T : ℕ) (d : Fin (K + 1)) (hT : (T : ℝ) < scaleThreshold a) :
    (atlasFamily P K k r a width logQ accept ha hw hw1 hkr).ambient T d = 0 :=
  atlasAmbient_zero_below_threshold P k r a width logQ accept T d.val hT

theorem atlasFamily_zero_of_rank_ne (P : Plan) (K k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ)
    (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hw : 0 < width) (hw1 : width ≤ 1) (hkr : k + 2 + r ≤ K)
    (T : ℕ) (d : Fin (K + 1)) (hd : d.val ≠ k + (2 + r)) :
    (atlasFamily P K k r a width logQ accept ha hw hw1 hkr).ambient T d = 0 :=
  atlasAmbient_zero_of_rank_ne P k r a width logQ accept T d.val hd

theorem atlasFamily_nonneg (P : Plan) (K k r : ℕ) (a width : ℝ)
    (logQ : ℕ → ℝ) (accept : ℕ → (Fin k → Code P) → Prop)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hw : 0 < width) (hw1 : width ≤ 1) (hkr : k + 2 + r ≤ K)
    (T : ℕ) (d : Fin (K + 1)) (v : Fin d.val → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (atlasFamily P K k r a width logQ accept ha hw hw1 hkr).ambient T d v :=
  atlasAmbient_nonneg P k r a width logQ accept T d.val v

end
end ImbalancedChen.P2FiniteMarkedGamma5AtlasFamily

import ImbalancedChen.Part5OriginalCausalSmoothAtlas

/-!
SOURCE ONLY / UNCOMPILED / ZERO NEW MATHEMATICAL CREDIT.
Exact original finite smooth readout declarations and proof texts, relocated
from JointQueryEnclosure without changing their fully qualified names.
This isolates the geometric readout from the original arithmetic-history
imports. The full original owner must use the matching removal postimage.
-/
namespace ImbalancedChen.Part5OriginalH430JointQueryEnclosure
noncomputable section
open Set
open scoped Classical BigOperators ContDiff
open Part5OriginalCausalSmoothAtlas

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

def Cube (x : ι → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1
def hit (P : Plan) (D : Set (ι → ℝ)) (j : ι → Code P) : Prop :=
  ∃ x, Cube x ∧ atom P j x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ D
def sure (P : Plan) (D : Set (ι → ℝ)) (j : ι → Code P) : Prop :=
  hit P D j ∧ ¬hit P Dᶜ j
def mixed (P : Plan) (D : Set (ι → ℝ)) (j : ι → Code P) : Prop :=
  hit P D j ∧ hit P Dᶜ j
def readout (P : Plan) (accept : (ι → Code P) → Prop) (x : ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j : ι → Code P, if accept j then atom P j x else 0

theorem readout_smooth (P : Plan) (accept : (ι → Code P) → Prop) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (readout P accept) := by
  classical
  unfold readout
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro j _
  by_cases h : accept j
  · simpa only [if_pos h] using atom_smooth P j
  · simp only [if_neg h]; exact contDiff_const

theorem gap_exact (P : Plan) (D : Set (ι → ℝ)) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    readout P (hit P D) x = readout P (sure P D) x + readout P (mixed P D) x := by
  classical
  unfold readout
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  by_cases h : hit P D j <;> by_cases h' : hit P Dᶜ j <;> simp [h,h',sure,mixed]

theorem sharp_sandwich (P : Plan) (D : Set (ι → ℝ)) {x : ι → ℝ} (hx : Cube x) :
    readout P (sure P D) x ≤ (if x ∈ D then 1 else 0) ∧
      (if x ∈ D then 1 else 0) ≤ readout P (hit P D) x := by
  classical
  have hone := atom_total P hx
  by_cases h : x ∈ D
  · rw [if_pos h, ← hone]
    constructor
    · exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by
        by_cases hs : sure P D j <;> simp [hs,atom_nonneg])
    · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      by_cases hh : hit P D j
      · simp [hh]
      · have hz : atom P j x = 0 := by
          by_contra hn
          exact hh ⟨x,hx,hn,h⟩
        simp [hh,hz]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    constructor
    · apply le_of_eq
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro j _
      by_cases hs : sure P D j
      · rw [if_pos hs]
        by_contra hn
        exact hs.2 ⟨x,hx,hn,h⟩
      · simp [hs]
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs <;> simp [atom_nonneg])

/-- Identical positive-mass knot / inherit faces in the chart cost zero if the
predicate is constant there. Restriction is to a *single fixed original*
stratum; this lemma itself supplies no permission to discard its complement. -/
theorem no_mixed_of_constant (P : Plan) (D : Set (ι → ℝ)) (v : Prop)
    (hc : ∀ x, Cube x → (x ∈ D ↔ v)) (j : ι → Code P) : ¬mixed P D j := by
  rintro ⟨⟨x,hx,_,hy⟩,⟨z,hz,_,hn⟩⟩
  exact hn ((hc z hz).mpr ((hc x hx).mp hy))

/-- A mixed mask for a fine grid exhibits actual opposite full-query answers
at points within its physical native-coordinate diameter. The converse and
smallness of the measure of this set are not presumed. -/
theorem mixed_neighbours (m : ℕ) (D : Set (ι → ℝ)) (j : ι → Code (.mesh m))
    (h : mixed (.mesh m) D j) :
    ∃ x y, Cube x ∧ Cube y ∧ x ∈ D ∧ y ∉ D ∧
      ∀ i, |x i-y i| < 4 * width m := by
  obtain ⟨⟨x,hx,hxj,hD⟩,⟨y,hy,hyj,hn⟩⟩ := h
  refine ⟨x,y,hx,hy,hD,hn,?_⟩
  intro i
  apply mesh_diameter m (j i)
  · exact fun hz => hxj (Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) hz)
  · exact fun hz => hyj (Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) hz)

end
end ImbalancedChen.Part5OriginalH430JointQueryEnclosure

import ImbalancedChen.P4BSmoothGateUpperStep
import ImbalancedChen.LogPrimeBoxMesh
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Support

/-!
SOURCE ONLY / UNCOMPILED / ZERO FORMAL CREDIT.
Actual finite rough-log-grid label weights are consecutive differences
of ONE canonical monotone smooth step. Their sum telescopes exactly;
there is no bump normalization or assumed partition certificate. The
left enlargement and right endpoint strip are retained pointwise,
including every arithmetic prime on a literal endpoint.
-/
namespace ImbalancedChen.P5Z.RoughLogGridSmoothPartition
noncomputable section
open Set Classical
open scoped BigOperators
open P4B

def left (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ := logPrimeMeshPoint a b n j.val
def right (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ := logPrimeMeshPoint a b n (j.val + 1)

def label (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - left a b n j) - smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - right a b n j)

theorem left_le_right {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    left a b n j ≤ right a b n j := logPrimeMeshPoint_mono hab n (Nat.le_succ _)

theorem label_bounds {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ label a b n δ j x ∧ label a b n δ j x ≤ 1 := by
  have hlr := left_le_right hab n j
  have hmono := monotone_smoothGateUpperStep hδ (show x - right a b n j ≤ x - left a b n j by linarith)
  have hl := smoothGateUpperStep_bounds δ (x - left a b n j)
  have hr := smoothGateUpperStep_bounds δ (x - right a b n j)
  unfold label
  constructor <;> linarith

/-- EXACT finite telescoping, before any limiting measure or prime sum. -/
theorem sum_labels (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (δ x : ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), label a b n δ j x) =
      smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - a) - smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - b) := by
  unfold label left right
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (f := fun k : ℕ =>
    smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - logPrimeMeshPoint a b n k) -
      smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - logPrimeMeshPoint a b n (k + 1)))]
  simpa only [logPrimeMeshPoint_zero, logPrimeMeshPoint_last] using
    Finset.sum_range_sub' (fun k : ℕ => smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - logPrimeMeshPoint a b n k)) (n + 1)

theorem sum_labels_bounds {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), label a b n δ j x ∧
      (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), label a b n δ j x) ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => (label_bounds hab hδ n j x).1)
  · rw [sum_labels]
    linarith [(smoothGateUpperStep_bounds δ (x - a)).2, (smoothGateUpperStep_bounds δ (x - b)).1]

/-- Partition plateau on the ACTUAL interior carrier. The upper boundary
strip is not discarded; its endpoint x=b-delta is included in the plateau. -/
theorem sum_labels_eq_one {a b δ x : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (ha : a ≤ x) (hb : x ≤ b - δ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), label a b n δ j x) = 1 := by
  have hl : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - a) = 1 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_one hδ (by linarith)
  have hr : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - b) = 0 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_zero hδ (by linarith)
  rw [sum_labels, hl, hr, sub_zero]

theorem label_zero_left {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ left a b n j - δ) : label a b n δ j x = 0 := by
  have hlr := left_le_right hab n j
  have hl : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - left a b n j) = 0 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_zero hδ (by linarith)
  have hr : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - right a b n j) = 0 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_zero hδ (by linarith)
  rw [label, hl, hr, sub_self]

theorem label_zero_right {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) {x : ℝ} (hx : right a b n j ≤ x) : label a b n δ j x = 0 := by
  have hlr := left_le_right hab n j
  have hl : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - left a b n j) = 1 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_one hδ (by linarith)
  have hr : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - right a b n j) = 1 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_one hδ (by linarith)
  rw [label, hl, hr, sub_self]

/-- Nonzero label support is an ENLARGED original cell with exact strict
support endpoints. No arithmetic disjointness of labels is claimed. -/
theorem label_nonzero_support {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) {x : ℝ} (hx : label a b n δ j x ≠ 0) :
    left a b n j - δ < x ∧ x < right a b n j := by
  constructor
  · exact lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hx (label_zero_left hab hδ n j h))
  · exact lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hx (label_zero_right hab hδ n j h))

theorem contDiff_label (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) {k : ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ k (label a b n δ j) :=
  ((contDiff_smoothGateUpperStep δ).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).sub
    ((contDiff_smoothGateUpperStep δ).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))

theorem hasCompactSupport_label {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : HasCompactSupport (label a b n δ j) := by
  apply HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact
    (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (left a b n j - δ) (right a b n j)))
  intro x hx
  have h := label_nonzero_support hab hδ n j hx
  exact ⟨h.1.le, h.2.le⟩

def literal (a b x : ℝ) : ℝ := if a ≤ x ∧ x < b then 1 else 0

/-- Exact endpoint reserve for the telescoped partition versus the
literal inclusive-lower/strict-upper rough carrier. -/
def endpointReserve (a b δ x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (a - δ < x ∧ x < a) ∨ (b - δ < x ∧ x < b)

theorem partition_error_supported {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ)
    (he : (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), label a b n δ j x) - literal a b x ≠ 0) : endpointReserve a b δ x := by
  by_cases ha : x < a
  · left
    refine ⟨?_, ha⟩
    by_contra hn
    have hx : x ≤ a - δ := le_of_not_gt hn
    have hl : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - a) = 0 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_zero hδ (by linarith)
    have hr : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - b) = 0 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_zero hδ (by linarith)
    exact he (by simp [sum_labels, literal, not_le.mpr ha, hl, hr])
  · have hax : a ≤ x := le_of_not_gt ha
    have hxb : x < b := by
      by_contra hn
      have hb : b ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hn
      have hl : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - a) = 1 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_one hδ (by linarith)
      have hr : smoothGateUpperStep δ (x - b) = 1 := smoothGateUpperStep_eq_one hδ (by linarith)
      exact he (by simp [sum_labels, literal, not_lt.mpr hb, hl, hr])
    right
    refine ⟨?_, hxb⟩
    by_contra hn
    have hx : x ≤ b - δ := le_of_not_gt hn
    exact he (by simp [sum_labels_eq_one hδ hax hx n, literal, hax, hxb])

end
end ImbalancedChen.P5Z.RoughLogGridSmoothPartition

import ImbalancedChen.P5RoughLogGridSmoothPartition
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.FTaylorSeries
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Bounded

/-! A finite common smooth partition on the *original* log-prime coordinates.
The margin [-1,2] makes both ends of [0,1] part of the exact plateau.
`join` retains the two old tests as factors, even with unrelated meshes.
Refining the native word by future slots leaves every earlier marginal unchanged.
Source only. No arithmetic small-error or uniform-in-N density theorem is assumed. -/
namespace ImbalancedChen.Part5OriginalCausalSmoothAtlas
noncomputable section
open Set Filter
open scoped Classical BigOperators Topology ContDiff
open P5Z.RoughLogGridSmoothPartition

def width (m : ℕ) : ℝ := 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)
theorem width_pos (m : ℕ) : 0 < width m := by unfold width; positivity
theorem width_le_one (m : ℕ) : width m ≤ 1 := by
  unfold width
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (m : ℝ)+1)).mpr
  simp

/-- All cuts, including widths and the order of joins, are fixed without N. -/
inductive Plan where
  | mesh (m : ℕ)
  | join (old fresh : Plan)

noncomputable def Code : Plan → Type
  | .mesh m => Fin (m+1)
  | .join P Q => Code P × Code Q

@[instance_reducible] private noncomputable def codeType : (P : Plan) → Fintype (Code P)
  | .mesh m => inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin (m+1)))
  | .join P Q => by
    letI : Fintype (Code P) := codeType P
    letI : Fintype (Code Q) := codeType Q
    exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Code P × Code Q))

instance (P : Plan) : Fintype (Code P) := codeType P

noncomputable def mask : (P : Plan) → Code P → ℝ → ℝ
  | .mesh m, j, x => label (-1) 2 m (width m) j x
  | .join P Q, j, x => mask P j.1 x * mask Q j.2 x

theorem mask_nonneg (P : Plan) (j : Code P) (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ mask P j x := by
  induction P with
  | mesh m => exact (label_bounds (by norm_num : (-1:ℝ) ≤ 2) (width_pos m) m j x).1
  | join P Q hP hQ => exact mul_nonneg (hP j.1) (hQ j.2)

theorem mask_le_one (P : Plan) (j : Code P) (x : ℝ) : mask P j x ≤ 1 := by
  induction P with
  | mesh m => exact (label_bounds (by norm_num : (-1:ℝ) ≤ 2) (width_pos m) m j x).2
  | join P Q hP hQ =>
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hP j.1) (mask_nonneg Q j.2 x)).trans
      (by simpa only [one_mul] using hQ j.2)

theorem mask_smooth (P : Plan) (j : Code P) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (mask P j) := by
  induction P with
  | mesh m => exact contDiff_label (-1) 2 m (width m) j
  | join P Q hP hQ => exact (hP j.1).mul (hQ j.2)

theorem mask_compact (P : Plan) (j : Code P) : HasCompactSupport (mask P j) := by
  induction P with
  | mesh m => exact hasCompactSupport_label (by norm_num : (-1:ℝ) ≤ 2) (width_pos m) m j
  | join P Q hP _ =>
    apply HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact
      (hP j.1 : IsCompact (tsupport (mask P j.1)))
    intro x hx
    exact subset_closure (show mask P j.1 x ≠ 0 from (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hx).1)

theorem mask_total (P : Plan) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    (∑ j : Code P, mask P j x) = 1 := by
  induction P with
  | mesh m =>
    exact sum_labels_eq_one (width_pos m) (by linarith [hx.1] : (-1:ℝ) ≤ x)
      (by linarith [hx.2,width_le_one m] : x ≤ 2 - width m) m
  | join P Q hP hQ =>
    change (∑ j : Code P × Code Q, mask P j.1 x * mask Q j.2 x) = 1
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, hQ, mul_one, hP]

/-- Any finite list of requested precisions fits into ONE common positive plan. -/
noncomputable def overlay (P : Plan) : List Plan → Plan
  | [] => P
  | Q :: qs => .join (overlay P qs) Q

noncomputable def restrictOld (P : Plan) : (qs : List Plan) → Code (overlay P qs) → Code P
  | [], j => j
  | _ :: qs, j => restrictOld P qs j.1

/-- A particular occurrence of any chart inside the binary overlay tree,
including repeated equal meshes. Left/right are part of the address. -/
inductive Factor (A : Plan) : Plan → Type
  | here : Factor A A
  | left {P Q : Plan} (p : Factor A P) : Factor A (.join P Q)
  | right {P Q : Plan} (p : Factor A Q) : Factor A (.join P Q)

noncomputable def Factor.read {A : Plan} : {P : Plan} → Factor A P → Code P → Code A
  | _, .here, j => j
  | _, .left p, j => p.read j.1
  | _, .right p, j => p.read j.2

theorem factor_of_mem {A : Plan} (P : Plan) {qs : List Plan} (h : A ∈ qs) :
    Nonempty (Factor A (overlay P qs)) := by
  induction qs with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons Q qs ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h | h
    · subst Q; exact ⟨.right .here⟩
    · obtain ⟨p⟩ := ih h; exact ⟨.left p⟩

theorem factor_marginal {A P : Plan} (p : Factor A P) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (F : Code A → ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Code P, mask P j x * F (p.read j)) = ∑ j : Code A, mask A j x * F j := by
  induction p with
  | here => rfl
  | @left P Q p ih =>
    change (∑ j : Code P × Code Q, (mask P j.1 x * mask Q j.2 x) * F (p.read j.1)) = _
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : Code P, (mask P j x * F (p.read j)) * ∑ k : Code Q, mask Q k x := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _; ring
      _ = _ := by simpa only [mask_total Q hx,mul_one] using ih
  | @right P Q p ih =>
    change (∑ j : Code P × Code Q, (mask P j.1 x * mask Q j.2 x) * F (p.read j.2)) = _
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, mask_total P hx, one_mul]
    exact ih

/-- Exact marginal of *all* other precisions on the same slot. No monotonicity
of a local analytic estimate under mesh or cap changes is used. -/
theorem overlay_marginal (P : Plan) (qs : List Plan) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (F : Code P → ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Code (overlay P qs), mask (overlay P qs) j x * F (restrictOld P qs j)) =
      ∑ j : Code P, mask P j x * F j := by
  induction qs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons Q qs ih =>
    change (∑ j : Code (overlay P qs) × Code Q,
      (mask (overlay P qs) j.1 x * mask Q j.2 x) * F (restrictOld P qs j.1)) = _
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : Code (overlay P qs),
          (mask (overlay P qs) j x * F (restrictOld P qs j)) * ∑ k : Code Q, mask Q k x := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        ring
      _ = _ := by simpa only [mask_total Q hx,mul_one] using ih

abbrev Box (P : Plan) (r : ℕ) := Fin r → Code P
def atom {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : Plan) (j : ι → Code P) (x : ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i, mask P (j i) (x i)

theorem atom_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : Plan) (j : ι → Code P) (x : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ atom P j x :=
  Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => mask_nonneg P (j i) (x i))

theorem atom_le_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : Plan) (j : ι → Code P) (x : ι → ℝ) : atom P j x ≤ 1 :=
  (Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => mask_nonneg P (j i) (x i))
    (fun i _ => mask_le_one P (j i) (x i))).trans_eq (by simp)

theorem atom_smooth {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : Plan) (j : ι → Code P) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (atom P j) := by
  unfold atom
  apply contDiff_prod
  intro i _
  exact (mask_smooth P (j i)).comp (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ i)

theorem atom_total {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : Plan) {x : ι → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : (∑ j : ι → Code P, atom P j x) = 1 := by
  unfold atom
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun i (j : Code P) => mask P j (x i))]
  simp only [fun i => mask_total P (hx i), Finset.prod_const_one]

theorem atom_append {r s : ℕ} (P : Plan) (j : Box P r) (k : Box P s)
    (x : Fin r → ℝ) (y : Fin s → ℝ) :
    atom P (Fin.append j k) (Fin.append x y) = atom P j x * atom P k y := by
  unfold atom
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_add]
  simp only [Fin.append_left,Fin.append_right]

/-- For each fixed earlier label, summing *only future* labels gives back
its earlier weight, before integration, positivity, primes or division by Θ.
Rank zero is included, so fixed-point/retained reads append no dummy prime. -/
theorem prefix_marginal {r s : ℕ} (P : Plan) (j : Box P r)
    (x : Fin r → ℝ) {y : Fin s → ℝ} (hy : ∀ i, y i ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    (∑ k : Box P s, atom P (Fin.append j k) (Fin.append x y)) = atom P j x := by
  simp only [atom_append, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have htotal : (∑ k : Box P s, atom P k y) = 1 := by
    convert atom_total P hy using 2
    ext k
    simp
  exact (congrArg (fun t : ℝ => atom P j x * t) htotal).trans (mul_one _)

/-- Multiplying a signed term by the positive split does not alter its sign
or its total. Applicable to bases, fixed reads, floor losses and zero mass. -/
theorem integrate_constant {r : ℕ} (P : Plan) {x : Fin r → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (v : ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Box P r, atom P j x * v) = v := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  have htotal : (∑ j : Box P r, atom P j x) = 1 := by
    convert atom_total P hx using 2
    ext k
    simp
  exact (congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t * v) htotal).trans (one_mul _)

/-- The new independent chart can be as fine as requested BEFORE N.
Points sharing a nonzero one-dimensional label are <4/(m+1) apart. -/
theorem mesh_diameter (m : ℕ) (j : Code (.mesh m)) {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : mask (.mesh m) j x ≠ 0) (hy : mask (.mesh m) j y ≠ 0) :
    |x-y| < 4 * width m := by
  have h₁ := label_nonzero_support (by norm_num : (-1:ℝ) ≤ 2) (width_pos m) m j hx
  have h₂ := label_nonzero_support (by norm_num : (-1:ℝ) ≤ 2) (width_pos m) m j hy
  have hstep : right (-1) 2 m j = left (-1) 2 m j + 3 * width m := by
    change logPrimeMeshPoint (-1) 2 m (j.val + 1) =
      logPrimeMeshPoint (-1) 2 m j.val + 3 * width m
    rw [logPrimeMeshPoint_succ]
    unfold logPrimeMeshStep width
    ring
  rw [hstep] at h₁ h₂
  exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [h₁.1,h₂.2],by linarith [h₁.2,h₂.1]⟩

theorem choose_fine_mesh {eta : ℝ} (he : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∀ (j : Code (.mesh m)) (x y : ℝ),
      mask (.mesh m) j x ≠ 0 → mask (.mesh m) j y ≠ 0 → |x-y| < eta := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ((tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_lt_nhds (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < eta / 4))).exists
  change width m < eta / 4 at hm
  exact ⟨m, fun j x y hx hy => (mesh_diameter m j hx hy).trans (by linarith)⟩
